title: Higher regularity of regular free boundaries for the Kolmogorov obstacle problem
summary: We establish higher regularity of the regular free boundary for non-negative solutions of the Kolmogorov obstacle problem \[ \mathcal K u=χ_{\{u>0\}}, \qquad \mathcal K=Δ_x+x\cdot\nabla_y-\partial_t. \] Assume that the contact set satisfies a quantitative thickness condition at a free-boundary point. We prove that, in a neighborhood of that point, the free boundary is a non-characteristic \(C_{\mathcal K}^{1,β}\) hypersurface for some \(β\in(0,1)\).
